annotations.text:
The brief: assert why the greats are great — Richter, Haydn, Boccherini, Mozart, Beethoven, Bartok, Shostakovich — and surface the outliers like Cambini.

All four charts are drawn from composers.json, not sketched: same scales, same 0.35 radius exponent, same jitter hash as the app. Pick a direction and I build it.
